issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, allowing slashes or query strings in IDs to change the request target.
Transient httpx transport errors and timeouts are not retried or wrapped in LumenAPIError, so network failures leak raw exceptions.
Malformed list or batch response shapes are silently ignored instead of raising, which can hide data loss and API contract breaks.
Model parsers coerce and trust API fields instead of validating required types and Literal values, masking invalid server data.
Error.retryable is parsed with bool(), so string values like "false" become True and can cause incorrect retries.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date values, causing noncompliant rate-limit backoff behavior.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable despite documenting support for any iterable, which can exhaust memory for large inputs.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading 'request was not attempted' error.
review always sends note:null when no note is provided, which may differ from omitting the optional field.
Public Literal type aliases used by the client API are not exported, so users cannot import ReviewVerdict or related status types from lumen.
Project has pytest configuration but no configured formatter, linter, type checker, or CI entry point for ongoing maintenance.
